title: Lexicon Technicum: OR, AN Universal English Dictionary OF ARTS AND SCIENCES
author: John Harris
words_note: 1,875,399 is the cleaned-text total from the cleanup report (vol. 1: 865,692; vol. 2: 1,009,707). Entries text totals 1841170 words; the remainder is front matter, back matter, running heads and text the parser never assigned to an entry.
letters_note: The book has J and U sections in volume 2 (J: 56 entries; U: 73 entries), unlike the 1704, 1708-1710 and 1723-1725 editions. Volume 1 (A-H) has no J or U. The data holds j.json and u.json so those entries are reachable by search: the site looks an entry up by the first letter of its key. Several U headwords are U-for-V spellings as printed (ULCER, ULNA); some lost an initial letter (UINTESSENCE for QUINTESSENCE, USPENSION for SUSPENSION) and are kept as printed.
corrections_note: 147,558 by the cleanup engine (long-s 131,309; one-letter edits 7,297; hyphen rejoins 8,293; longs_edit 409; ct/V-to-U 100; run-on splits 74; splits 76) + 8,033 by the sentence context pass + 3 page-validated fixes.
unresolved: 42,536 occurrences (36,124 distinct tokens) left as-is, plus 30,805 ambiguous occurrences; see lexicon-technicum-1736-unresolved.md.
citation: The book has no printed page numbers. Cite entries by volume, letter section and headword, never by page.
front_matter_note: The front matter is kept as the OCR printed it, including its garble (vol. 1 opens with scan junk). A transcription repair from the printed page images follows, as was done for the 1704, 1708-1710, 1716 and 1723-1725 editions. The two back-matter records are also parser leftovers (fragments of entry tails), kept as-is.
lost_entries_note: ABDOMINAL appears in definitions only, with no entry; SECONDARY Planets appears in the PLANET/MOON articles only, with no entry (the 1716 edition had it). Recorded as lost, not invented.
recovered_entries: TORE, or Torus (plus a separate TORUS entry)
SECTA unica tantum facienda pro pluribus haereditatibus
recovered_entries_note: Entries lost in the earlier editions and recovered in the 1736, each confirmed against the printed page.
duplicated_leaf_range_note: BIM vol. 2 duplicated a leaf range, so entries.json holds two PRINCIPLE entries (2,603 and 10,840 words) and two each of PRINCIPAL, PRINCIPAL Ray and PRINCIPAL Point. NO dedupe was applied in this build: checking both scans showed neither PRINCIPLE entry is the genuine article alone — both are run-on monsters, because the parser never split the PRINTING headword (it ends with a period, not a comma). Wellcome vol. 2 (no duplication) reads PRINCIPAL, PRINCIPAL Ray, PRINCIPAL Point, PRINCIPLE, PRINTING, PRINTS, PRIORITY, PRISAGE, PRISM, and PRINTING/PRINTS exist as entries nowhere in entries.json — their text survives only inside the two PRINCIPLE entries, and the 10,840-word one holds the latter part of PRINTING plus PRINTS, which the 2,603-word one does not reach. Dropping it would delete that text from the site. Both copies are kept; the duplication is flagged here for a later decision.
monsters: PRINCIPLE (10,840 words — run-on monster, see duplicated_leaf_range_note)
monsters_note: Longest entries, checked for missed headwords inside them; all genuine treatise-articles except PRINCIPLE, which swallowed the PRINTING and PRINTS articles because their headwords were never split. See duplicated_leaf_range_note.
